models.note: DeepSeek V4 (pro, flash, flash-vision-exp, …): hybrid thinking — the API accepts reasoning_effort high/max only while thinking is enabled (isDeepSeekV4ReasoningEffortModel, modelSupportsReasoningEffortWhileThinking).
DeepSeek R1 always thinks and has no thinking toggle (isDeepSeekReasoningOnlyModel; the source additionally gates on the direct deepseek provider).
